entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my ID is 301. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help you with that. Could I please get your name and the order number?

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here for the Velocity Pro jersey. Let me just confirm... it looks like it was delivered 9 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's the wrong size. I ordered a large.
I see. And the issue is with the sizing you received?
The jersey is just way too tight. It's supposed to be a large, but it fits like a small. Whatever.

I understand completely, and I apologize for the inconvenience. Sizing can sometimes be tricky. Since you're well within the 90-day return window for apparel, we can definitely process a return or an exchange for you. Which would you prefer?
Fine. An exchange, I guess. For a size that actually fits.

Of course. I see you're one of our VIP members, Sarah, and we really appreciate your loyalty. To make this easier, I can place the order for the new size, an extra-large, right now, and I'll add complimentary expedited shipping so it gets to you much faster. I'll also email you a prepaid return label for the jersey that's too tight. You can just drop it in the mail at your convenience.
So I don't have to wait for you to get the old one back first?
That's correct. As a VIP, we're happy to send the replacement out immediately. The new order will be on its way this afternoon.
Okay. I suppose that's fine. Just make sure it's the right one this time.

Absolutely. I've just placed the exchange order for the extra-large Velocity Pro jersey. Your new order number is VF991430, and you should see the confirmation and the return label in your email within the next 5 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Sarah. Have a great day.
